title: EIOPA Report on the impacts of climate change on life and health and potential emerging risks for the insurance and IORP sectors
Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: The report identifies extreme heat as the leading climate-related liability risk for life and health insurers and occupational pension providers, noting that current financial impacts are limited but risks are expected to increase in coming decades.

title: Consulta Pública n.º 6/2026 Projeto de Norma Regulamentar que estabelece os índices trimestrais de atualização de capitais para as apólices do ramo "Incêndio e elementos da natureza" com início ou vencimento no primeiro trimestre de 2027
Issuer: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)
Summary: The ASF is consulting on a draft regulatory standard setting quarterly capital adjustment indices for fire and natural elements insurance policies beginning or renewing in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Instrução (Histórico) n.º 8/2026
Summary: This instruction revokes Instruction No. 7/2019 and applies to credit institutions headquartered in Portugal.

title: Report on taxonomy disclosures
Summary: The EBA report analyses taxonomy disclosure requirements under Article 8 of the Taxonomy Regulation and provides technical advice on financial-sector KPIs, grandfathering, voluntary use of OpEx, group-level reporting, asset management and investment activities, and credit-institution templates.

title: Consultation paper on draft RTS on Operational Risk management framework
Summary: The EBA consults on draft regulatory technical standards establishing a harmonised, proportionate framework for institutions’ operational risk governance, management processes, assessment systems, data, reporting, validation, audit and data governance.

title: Regulatory Technical Standards on prudential requirements for central securities depositories (CSDs) designated credit institutions offering ‘banking-type ancillary services’
Summary: The EBA’s final report proposes amendments to the prudential technical standards for central securities depositories and designated credit institutions, addressing risks arising when banking CSDs provide banking-type ancillary services to participants of other CSDs and updating references to reflect changes in EU legislation.

title: Final report on the revised CSDR Guidelines on standardised procedures and messaging protocols used between investment firms and their professional clients
Summary: ESMA’s final report presents revised CSDR guidelines on arrangements, communication procedures and messaging protocols for investment firms and their professional clients, including the use of electronic and international open standards.

title: Final report on the guarantees as CCP collateral and CCP investment policy
Summary: ESMA’s final report sets out draft amendments to RTS 153/2013 specifying conditions for CCP acceptance of public and bank guarantees as collateral and making targeted changes to CCP investment policy and secure deposit arrangements.

title: Circular 007/2026 - Gestão de Ativos - Deveres em matéria de requisitos prudenciais e práticas de comercialização para os organismos de investimento alternativo de capital de risco
Issuer: Comissão do Mercado de Valores Mobiliários (CMVM)
Summary: The CMVM circular sets out supervisory expectations for venture capital alternative investment fund managers on investment and risk management structures, investment eligibility and limits, marketing practices, pre-contractual disclosures, appropriateness assessments, and costs and charges.

title: Consultation on the draft Supervisory Statement on IBIP Sales Processes
Issuer: European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority (EIOPA)
Summary: EIOPA is consulting on a draft Supervisory Statement to promote consistent, proportionate and risk-based supervision of IBIP sales processes and pre-contractual disclosures without introducing new regulatory requirements or prescribed supervisory methods.
